provenance.method: Bounded review of the National Autistic Society Online Community public description; community participation is not treated as professional advice.

name: National Autistic Society Online Community
description: Online community for autistic people and families to ask questions, connect and share experiences.
intended_use: A peer-community route for people who want lived-experience discussion rather than a clinical or professional answer.
audience_or_context: Autistic people and families using an online peer space; community rules, privacy and moderation terms apply.
limitations: Peer posts are personal experiences and should not be treated as medical, legal or financial advice.
Online communities can vary in tone, moderation, social demand and privacy fit.
cost_or_access_notes: Check the current community registration, moderation and privacy terms before joining.
